title: PonsRAG: A Pons-Inspired RAG Bridging Cognitive Islands for Coordinated Long Narrative Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.25486v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long Narrative Reasoning is an essential capability for processing and reasoning over complex narratives. While retrieval-augmented generation provides a promising framework, existing methods still face two critical challenges: cognitive islanding and cross-layer evidence disconnection. To address these issues, we propose PonsRAG, a coordinated RAG framework inspired by the biological pons. PonsRAG consists of two key components: Triple-Layer Indexing, which organizes documents into a connected knowledge structure to bridge cognitive islands, and Coordinated Reasoning, which retrieves evidence across distinct layers and integrates cross-layer information into a unified context. We evaluate PonsRAG on four long-context narrative benchmarks, and experimental results show that it outperforms the strongest baseline, achieving a 11.56% relative improvement in average accuracy on multi-choice tasks.

translated_title: PonsRAG：一种受脑桥启发的RAG，桥接认知岛屿以实现协调的长叙事推理
translated_abstract: 长叙事推理是处理复杂叙事并对其推理的基本能力。虽然检索增强生成提供了一个有前景的框架，但现有方法仍面临两个关键挑战：认知岛屿化和跨层证据断连。为解决这些问题，我们提出了PonsRAG，一种受生物脑桥启发的协调RAG框架。PonsRAG包含两个关键组件：三层索引，它将文档组织成连接的知识结构以桥接认知岛屿；以及协调推理，它在不同层之间检索证据并将跨层信息整合到统一上下文中。我们在四个长上下文叙事基准上评估了PonsRAG，实验结果表明，它优于最强基线，在多选任务上的平均准确率相对提高了11.56%。
tldr: PonsRAG通过三层索引和协调推理机制，成功解决了长叙事推理中的认知岛屿化和跨层证据断连问题，在多选任务上平均准确率相对提升11.56%。
en_tdlr: PonsRAG addresses cognitive islanding and cross-layer evidence disconnection in long narrative reasoning via triple-layer indexing and coordinated reasoning, achieving an 11.56% relative accuracy improvement on multi-choice tasks.
